name: ANSC 4697W
title: Undergraduate Honors Thesis Writing in Animal Science
description: Writing of a formal thesis based on independent research conducted by the student. Thesis proposal and final thesis must follow guidelines developed by the department.
requirement_description: Three credits of ANSC 2699 or 5692, which may be taken concurrently; ENGL 1007 or 1010 or 1011; open to juniors or higher.
